does: Enters a status on its owner: marks it entered, lets statuses it replaces exit, raises the applied status event (0x10) - where the status's OnApplyRoll is evaluated - and then applies the prototype's settings.

evidence.says: esv::Status::Enter is a virtual of the server's status in the builds that carried symbols; this one calls esv::Status::IsOnSourceSurface and GetStatusMachine and is called by esv::StatusBoost::Enter and esv::StatusKnockedDown::Enter
a probe during Osi.ApplyStatus of HOLD_PERSON shows 1 call from esv::StatusBoost::Enter (+0x370DE4C); See Invisibility's save chain passes it at +0x2FFA091
